charts.title: LHS 1678 b: orbits around LHS 1678
charts.description: The orbits of LHS 1678's planets in this map from above, to scale, with LHS 1678 b highlighted and the direction to Earth down. Each orbit is the one the app draws, from the published period, a/R*, eccentricity and argument of periastron; the star is a marker, not to scale.

metadata.orbitSource: Silverstein et al. 2024 (2024AJ....167..255S), via the NASA Exoplanet Archive ps table (pl_refname SILVERSTEIN_ET_AL_2024): P 0.8602325 d

charts.title: LHS 1678 b: its transit
charts.description: LHS 1678 b crossing its star, as TESS recorded it: 3 sectors (31, 32, 98) of the SPOC pipeline's 2-minute light curves of TIC 77156829, each transit divided by a straight line fitted to the light either side and folded onto the orbit the app draws, then averaged in 4-minute bins. Error bars are each bin's standard error.
notes: Folded on the app's orbit; 4-min bins.
Bars: standard error of each bin.
